```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readxl)
library(writexl)
library(ggplot2)
library(irr)
library(scales)
```

```{r}
runs <- read_excel("5_runs_gemini.xlsx")
humans <- read_excel("Human.xlsx")

runs <- runs %>%
  inner_join(humans, by = c("Domain", "CiteID"))

runs <- runs[, c(1:7,11:13)]

partial_runs <- runs %>%
  mutate(across(
    c(ai_answer_1:ai_answer_5, Human__1, Human_2, Human_consensus),
    ~ case_when(
      . == "Low Risk" ~ "low",
      . == "Probably Low Risk" ~ "low",
      . == "Probably High Risk" ~ "high",
      . == "High Risk" ~ "high",
      TRUE ~ .
    )
  ))
```


```{r}
runs$all_same <- as.integer(
  apply(runs[, paste0("ai_answer_", 1:5)], 1, function(x) all(x == x[1]))
)

round((sum(runs$all_same)/length(runs$all_same))*100,0)

partial_runs$all_same <- as.integer(
  apply(partial_runs[, paste0("ai_answer_", 1:5)], 1, function(x) all(x == x[1]))
)

round((sum(partial_runs$all_same)/length(partial_runs$all_same))*100,0)

summary_agree <- runs %>%
  group_by(Domain) %>%
  summarise(percentage = round((sum(all_same)/length(all_same))*100, 0))

summary_partial <- partial_runs %>%
  group_by(Domain) %>%
  summarise(percentage = round((sum(all_same)/length(all_same))*100, 0))

#disagree <- runs %>% filter(all_same == 0)
```

```{r}

row_summaries <- lapply(1:nrow(runs), function(i) {
  row <- runs[i, ]
  article_id <- row$CiteID
  domain <- row$Domain
  
  # Get only the ai_answer columns
  ai_answers <- row[grep("^ai_answer_", names(runs))]
  
  # Remove NAs before counting
  ai_answers <- ai_answers[!is.na(ai_answers)]
  
  # Handle empty rows
  if(length(ai_answers) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(
      article_id_1 = article_id,
      Domain = domain,
      value = NA,
      count = 0,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
  
  counts <- table(ai_answers)
  
  data.frame(
    article_id_1 = article_id,
    Domain = domain,
    value = names(counts),
    count = as.vector(counts),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})
summary_df <- do.call(rbind, row_summaries)

summary_wide <- summary_df %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = value, 
              values_from = count,
              values_fill = 0)

#write_xlsx(summary_wide, "discrepancies.xlsx")
```


```{r}
##Exact match
runs$ai_matches_consensus <- as.integer(
  runs$ai_answer_1 == runs$Human_consensus |
  runs$ai_answer_2 == runs$Human_consensus |
  runs$ai_answer_3 == runs$Human_consensus |
  runs$ai_answer_4 == runs$Human_consensus |
  runs$ai_answer_5 == runs$Human_consensus
)

# Column 2: Check if any AI answer matches any human answer
runs$ai_matches_any_human <- as.integer(
  runs$ai_answer_1 %in% c(runs$Human__1, runs$Human_2, runs$Human_consensus) |
  runs$ai_answer_2 %in% c(runs$Human__1, runs$Human_2, runs$Human_consensus) |
  runs$ai_answer_3 %in% c(runs$Human__1, runs$Human_2, runs$Human_consensus) |
  runs$ai_answer_4 %in% c(runs$Human__1, runs$Human_2, runs$Human_consensus) |
  runs$ai_answer_5 %in% c(runs$Human__1, runs$Human_2, runs$Human_consensus)
)


overall_consensus <- round((sum(runs$ai_matches_consensus)/length(runs$ai_matches_consensus))*100,0)
any_consensus <- round((sum(runs$ai_matches_any_human)/length(runs$ai_matches_any_human))*100,0)



```

)


overall_consensus <- round((sum(partial_runs$ai_matches_consensus)/length(partial_runs$ai_matches_consensus))*100,0)
any_consensus <- round((sum(partial_runs$ai_matches_any_human)/length(partial_runs$ai_matches_any_human))*100,0)

```{r}
##Exact match
runs <- runs %>%
  mutate(
    most_voted = apply(
      select(., ai_answer_1:ai_answer_5), 
      1, 
      function(x) {
        names(sort(table(x), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
      }
    )
  )


runs$mv_matches_consensus <- as.integer(runs$most_voted == runs$Human_consensus)


round((sum(runs$mv_matches_consensus)/length(runs$mv_matches_consensus))*100,0)

##Partial match
partial_runs <- partial_runs %>%
  mutate(
    most_voted = apply(
      select(., ai_answer_1:ai_answer_5), 
      1, 
      function(x) {
        names(sort(table(x), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
      }
    )
  )


partial_runs$mv_matches_consensus <- as.integer(partial_runs$most_voted == partial_runs$Human_consensus)


round((sum(partial_runs$mv_matches_consensus)/length(partial_runs$mv_matches_consensus))*100,0)
```
